Maria G: Quick check — SOC2 milestone: who owns KMS -> audit-log ingestion? We need rotation events in staging by 2025-11-10 for evidence. Pinging infra & SRE. @ashwin.s @john_devops :eyes:
ashwin.s: I can own the evidence package (what to collect + attestations). Need infra to guarantee the audit pipeline emits envelope_key.rotate events and retains them for 90 days in staging.
john_devops: Can do. Two blockers: (1) keystore's rotation handler doesn't currently emit the new `envelope_key.rotate` event. (2) audit-ingest needs a mapping for `keystore.*` source. I'll open PRs.
john_devops: Plan: PR1 adds emit in keystore (small change), PR2 adds mapping in audit-ingest. Target PRs by EOD Friday 2025-10-24, staging deploy Mon 2025-10-27.
ashwin.s: Thanks — once PRs are up I can draft the evidence doc and example queries. Please tag me on the PRs.
lina_sre: FYI I'll add a smoke check in SRE smoke suite to assert presence of rotate event in staging: sample query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM staging.audit_logs
WHERE event_type = 'envelope_key.rotate' AND env = 'staging' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours';
```
Maria G: Perfect. Can someone add the expected log schema to the compliance doc? Link: https://internal.company/handbooks/soc2-keystore
john_devops: will do, adding schema section to PR2.
ashwin.s: One more ask — need retention confirmation (90 days) and a KMS owner for production attestation. Maria, can you confirm production owner?
Maria G: Production owner is @frank.k (secure infra). I'll loop him in.
frank.k: looping in — I can confirm retention in prod but need timeline for infra changes. If staging deploy is 10/27, prod roll can be 11/3 after validation.
Maria G: Ok locking milestone: staging evidence ready by 2025-10-28, prod attestation by 2025-11-05. Action items: john -> PR1/PR2, lina -> smoke check, ashwin -> evidence doc, frank -> prod retention confirmation.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-ingest-staging v1.12.0 -> 2025-10-27 03:00 UTC :rocket:
john_devops: ping for review on PRs @eng-qa @eng-security
ashwin.s: will review once PRs are up; thanks all :thumbsup:
